desk.meaning: Recognizable trading workstation, software and cursor; chart updates are data, cursor is manual attention.
desk.geometry: Beveled8.8×5.5 monitor at y4.2; front screen z.22. Layered metal shell, vented back, jointed stand,9.8×5.6 wood desk, individually modelled keycaps, mouse seam, lamp and cable loops. Chart uses actual 3D candlestick bodies/wicks registered to its screen coordinates.
desk.layers: Near keyboard/mouse; screen with actual chart and rule inspector; distant wall, lamp pool and shelf. Local screen light illuminates bezel/desk.
desk.motion: One chart identity with explicit sample-time rewind for BEFORE SIGNAL. Cursor screen-coordinate travel and button depression consume notice/manual-check/manual-submit. Configuration, closing tests and status use their named events.
desk.risks: No free-floating screen card, no long unattended full-device hold, no threshold/order confusion; text must fit at screen closeups.
desk.technique: Parent the OHLC geometry and canvas UI to the same monitor. Convert price to height with (price−99.90)/0.18 × chartHeight. The screen is at local z=.17; candles at z=.225, pointer z=.50. Camera can begin in front of individual extruded candles and pull out without swapping footage. 8.9×5.55×.30 monitor, 8.3×5 screen, 12×.32×6.4 desk. Keyboard: 5×15 keys with one spacebar. Wall and lamp establish physical scale. Use original candle body height when scaling the last candle; dividing by a generic minimum exaggerates price moves. The screen painter consumes deskDisplayState; its complete serialized state is the texture cache key, including late definition highlighting and current price. test-end reveals one, two, then three historical outcomes in sequence; the monitor-end word anchor restores the chart before the camera leaves the test area. Reporting uses the shared reported flag, not an earlier opacity threshold. V5 adds .48 maximum candle depth during the opening, easing back to native .08 by frame45. Monitor geometry is the actual sharp hero group; the room and desk use the separate depth pass. Macro optics come from visualDirection.desk. V5 cursor arrivals use the spoken anchorFrame for notice, manual-check and manual-submit. Notice targets the actual last-candle center from shared chart coordinates; checking points into the condition field. The attention ring shares that candle center.
desk.lighting: Cool display fill reflects on the metal bezel and keycaps; warm point light under the desk lamp supplies a localized amber pool. Object motion changes specular response; lights are fixed.
desk.hold: Monitor shell, keyboard, mouse, lamp, desk and wall retain their transforms. The last candle follows the market-change event; only the closing shot adds a small continuing quote oscillation. No live trading connection exists.
desk.adjustable: Event frames, camera knots, OHLC data and render settings are specification inputs. Dimensions and geometry formulas above are component-library constants; changing their construction requires authoring and a new moving proof.
desk.constraints: Keep identity and numeric state consistent across builders; use global frame evaluation, no accumulated delta-time. Typography must fit at both720px and360px. Light/material changes are not substitutes for a meaningful event.
desk.materials: V6 uses world-space longitudinal walnut grain with separate clearcoat, metal monitor bezel, low-opacity diagonal screen glass, individual keyboard keys, transparent drinking glass, lamp reflector/bulb and spotlight shadow pool. Screen spill is distinct from the warm lamp.
desk.camera: Shot camera knots begin between actual dimensional candles, pass through the screen, reveal the desk from above/left, then follow notice/check/place. Macro depth and focus aperture are consumed from visualDirection.desk.

configuration.meaning: The configured condition, quantity and limit are three properties of one stored rule, not three orders.
configuration.geometry: One 10.7 by 6.5 framed transparent chart with 27 extruded OHLC candles, a 100.00 threshold, three numbered quantity cubes, and a separate 100.05 price boundary.
configuration.layers: The three configured units occupy the foreground during the size phrase; actual chart geometry remains behind them; the grounded market-record terrain extends into depth.
configuration.motion: The condition line draws, exactly three units separate, and the price-limit plane extends into depth. The same chart tilts down toward the data field during the departure. No configuration action creates an order.
configuration.risks: Do not confuse the current quote with the limit price. Do not let a boundary line cover a numeral. Wider views must contain complete context labels; close views can crop context but never the active value.
configuration.technique: Reuse bars() with the same OHLC data and price projection as the desk, enlarged to 8.7 by 4.8, depth .30. The chart is at world Y3.6. The limit is a 10 by 5.4 translucent XZ plane placed at chart.level(100.05), with thin bounded edges. At the declared departure window the chart tilts to the ground and moves backward while the camera reaches the exact opening pose of the data family.

comparison.construction: Two views of the identical 27-candle OHLC sample on thin glass chart planes, each 10.7 by 5.5 with .40-depth candles, metal edge struts and shared price threshold. comparison.meaning: Attention response differs; the market and price path do not. Quantity and price limit remain the stored values. There is no outcome or profit comparison.
comparison.geometry: Two chart sheets at y=9 and y=2.1, rotations −.08 and +.08 radians; threshold at the shared bars.level(100); three .58 units. A CatmullRom route links the last candle to these units.
comparison.materials: Physical transparent glass .17 opacity, navy/gold/cyan primitives, metal rods; dense market terrain under both views.
comparison.camera: visualDirection.comparison.camera; quintic easing on global frame; pull from two views to automatic, then manual, then common chart.
comparison.animation: compare drives identical last-candle extension. automatic-action and manual-action each reveal route drawRange and three-unit instruction. no-prediction brings sheets to y=5.5 and aligns them; no-guarantee reveals future price candles. All actions are pure global-frame functions. Lower-view heading leaves at explicit labelFocusFrame2040 before the manual instruction occupies that projected area.

comparison.hold: Before manual action the cursor holds while the configured trace and three units change. After merging, future candles progress while earlier history remains fixed.
risks: No outcome comparison: do not add profit or winning directions.

The camera must fit full labels before selecting one view.
comparison.technique: V6 adds a visible100.01 record traveling along the actual condition-to-instruction curve, with a short light trail. This record causes the configured action; the manual cursor uses the same sample later. No profit or fill result is inferred.
